literal: If he is a hard-hearted person who speaks of separation, the hope that says 'he will bestow love' is impossible.
translation: If he is so hard-hearted as to speak of parting from me, any hope that he will return to bestow his love is completely futile.
modern: அவர் பிரிவைப் பற்றிப் பேசும் இரக்கமற்றவர் என்றால், அவர் மீண்டும் வந்து அன்பைச் சொரிவார் என்று நம்பும் நம்பிக்கை வீணானதாகும்.
explanation: In this couplet, the heroine expresses her despair to her companion upon hearing her lover talk of leaving. She describes him as 'van-kaṇṇar' (hard-hearted or cruel) because he is able to speak of separation without feeling her pain. She reasons that if he possesses such a cold heart, the hope ('nasai') that he will return to shower her with love ('nalguvar') is entirely futile ('aridu'). The verse highlights how the mere mention of parting shatters the heroine's trust in her lover's affection.
